CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is asserted.

COD.rationale: No single referent/time has explicit C,O and D bound together.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Explicitly identifies represented content (colour-labeled position sets).

D.rationale: Origins/flags (e.g. executed_branch_claim=false) separate content identity from representation/status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: Statements and explicit spatial-groupings describe how contents are organized/presented (peaks, spatial clusters).
